intro: Let your guests stay a little longer. With its cushioned seat and sleek ladder-back, our Ingrid chair makes every seat feel like the best in the house.

features.title: A finish to fall for
features.text: Our elegant walnut tone brings warmth and modern charm to your dining room—subtle, stylish, and full of character.

features.title: Perfect for small spaces
features.text: Compact yet comfortable, the Ingrid chair fits snugly around your table without crowding your space.

features.title: Comfort in every sit
features.text: The foam-cushioned seat wrapped in soft light brown fabric is made for your comfort—dinners feel more like lounging.

features.title: Breathe easy, sit pretty
features.text: The ladder-back design adds a stylish edge while offering support and ventilation for long, comfy meals.

features.title: Crafted to last
features.text: Made from solid wood, your chair is built to handle everyday use—durable enough to stay in the family for years.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
